$comment: What was decided for the repository on GitHub (LCH-C12), read daily by tools/watch/settings.mjs from watch.yml. A setting that drifts from this is a red line. When the owner's click and this file disagree three days running, this file is what changes, on the owner's word. `at: public` is a setting free only once the repository is public (LCH-C16): until then it reads 'waits on going public', not red.
